_comment: F13 Tidewake local chains (docs/design/WORLD.md, Tidewake - six new local chains). Each step is a host-validated record committed through the existing water_dock_action intent (scripts/world/water_local_chain_rules.gd): the host resolves the actor's identity and position, checks prerequisites and any per-character receipt, and writes world-scoped records under the declared world prefix water_claim: (water_claim:local:<chain>:<step>). Speech steps are requested by a guarded Water conversation (water_characters.json dialogue_event_guards, effect water:local_step:<id>); speech itself writes nothing. Rewards stay the existing pocket rows and their original receipts unless a step names a grant.
_comment_speech_radius: Water speech opens within 5 m of the speaker; the host allows 6 m of horizontal distance from the speaker's authored standing point for proxy/terrain slack.
_comment_site_radius: Site prompts open within 3.6 m of their prop; the host allows 4.8 m horizontally for proxy slack.

steps.refusal: Finish the sheltered swim lesson before Pell sends you further out.
steps.message: Pell's lead: the dry nook beneath Lantern Cove's rock arch, west of First Shore.

steps.claim_refusal: Take the cache from the dry nook beneath Lantern Cove's rock arch first, then swim back to Pell.
steps.refusal: Finish the sheltered swim lesson before Pell sends you further out.
steps.message: Pell marks your Lantern Cove return line. The swim back from the arch is yours to reuse.
Adair's request: recover the survey satchel left at Gull Rest, off Reedhaven's sheltered line.

steps._why_at: Inside reward pocket gull_research_satchel (radius 5 m), 4.5 m uphill of its Skill Candy II row so the two prompts never overlap; analytic ground 24.0 m, 16 degree slope.
steps.label: Recover Adair's survey satchel
steps.refusal: Surveyor Adair has not told you about this satchel yet.
steps.message: Survey satchel recovered: Adair's current observations. Carry them back on your next Brine Steps passage.

steps.refusal: Recover the survey satchel at Gull Rest first.
steps.message: Adair charts the safe Gull Rest crossing from the recovered observations.
Otto's lead: the dry shell nest on Tidal Cradle's upper slope, with exposed Reef Stone.

steps._why_requires: The nest's own world-once Reef Stone seam (water_pickups.json water:tidal_cradle:harvest:007, pickaxe, yield 4). The stone stays with whoever mined it; the return does not pay it again.
steps._why_swimmer: WORLD: return with a legal owned swimmer (a swim-mount compatible species in the requester's party) or after declining Aquaryn (the shared trial settled, whoever caught or defeated it). Never a requirement to catch Aquaryn.
steps.refusal: Mine the Reef Stone in the shell nest on Tidal Cradle's upper slope first.
steps.swimmer_refusal: Otto would rather meet the swimmer you travel with. Bring one of your own, or come back once Aquaryn's trial is settled either way.
steps.message: Otto shares 3 berries and marks where Mosshell, Riverdrake and Sirenseal swim.
Edda's request: copy the account on the Drowned Garden's exposed vault wall and bring it to Salt Crown.

steps._why_at: Inside reward pocket garden_exposed_vault (radius 5 m), 4.5 m east of its Skill Candy II row along the slope's contour, so the 4 m wall piece sits within 0.06 m of level ground end to end; analytic ground 27.8 m, well above the sea: no diving.
steps.label: Copy the vault wall's account
steps.refusal: Shrinekeeper Edda has not asked you to record this wall yet.
steps.message: Vault wall account copied: the old dock ledgers carved before the Tether. Bring it to Edda at Salt Crown.

steps.refusal: Copy the account on the Drowned Garden's vault wall first.
steps.message: Edda adds the vault's dock account to the Salt Crown records.
Halen's request: 4 driftwood and 4 reed fiber to roof the creature bed at the landing camp beside Lastlight.

steps._why_at: The existing legal camp water_camp_veilfall (camp at [381.661, 3822.923]; its creature bed at camp + (-4, 0)). The delivery prompt stands 3.5 m west of the bed on 6.6 degree ground, so it never overlaps the bed's own assign prompt. Veilfall exterior, beside the arrival landing; nowhere near the concealed interior staging area.
steps.label: Deliver shelter timber and reed
steps._why_done_model: The camp set's own tent, raised over the creature bed as its permanent shelter once the delivery is recorded (world-visible to every peer).
steps.materials_refusal: Halen's shelter needs 4 driftwood and 4 reed fiber.
steps.refusal: Campkeeper Halen has not asked for a shelter here yet.
steps.message: The creature bed at the Veilfall camp is sheltered now. Rest a companion there.

steps._why_bed: water_camp_veilfall creature_bed_index; the record follows the existing bed rest (creature_bed.gd), before or after Venn.
steps.rest_refusal: Rest one of your companions in the sheltered bed first.
steps.message: Your companion settles in the sheltered bed. Halen will want to hear it held.
